title: Feyenoord tem mudança na defesa e busca vitória contra Go Ahead Eagles
seoTitle: Feyenoord changes defense, seeks win over Go Ahead Eagles
subtitle: Treinador Van Bronckhorst mantém a base e aposta no retorno do defensor japonês
excerpt: In the season opener, Feyenoord retains most starters and counts on the return of Tsuyoshi Watanabe, while Go Ahead Eagles adjust their lineup for the match.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The clash between Feyenoord and Go Ahead Eagles, scheduled for Sunday afternoon at De Kuip, gained attention after manager Giovanni van Bronckhorst announced the sole change in the lineup: the return of Japanese defender Tsuyoshi Watanabe. The adjustment is expected to influence both the defensive strategy and the outcome expectations in the second round of the Eredivisie.

Feyenoord faces Go Ahead Eagles in a match at De Kuip

After a tight 1‑0 victory over neighbours Sparta, the Rotterdam side start the second round against the Deventenaren, who come off a 4‑1 win over Willem II. The match kicks off at 14:30, and the broadcast will be followed by fans who are tracking the liveblog of both teams.

Defensive change: return of Tsuyoshi Watanabe

Van Bronckhorst explained that Watanabe, who suffered an injury earlier this month, is fit again for the game. He said: "Hij heeft de hele week meegespeeld en is nu fit genoeg om te spelen". The Japanese defender replaces Thijs Kraaijeveld, who is left out of the starting eleven.

Options and doubts in Go Ahead's midfield

Coach Joseph Oosting chose not to field the midfielder who was not physically ready, stating: "Zover ik weet, speelt dat niet". Instead, he preferred Erik Flataker, justifying: "In deze wedstrijd hebben we meer een loper nodig, meer een speler die gevaarlijk is in de diepte. Stefan is meer een aanspeelpunt, dat is een tactische keuze". The decision reflects a search for greater dynamism in offensive transitions.

Giovanni van Bronckhorst's expectations for the debut

The Dutch coach kept most of the players he used against Sparta, retaining Charles Vanhoutte, Gjivai Zechiël and captain Luciano Valente in midfield. Up front, Anis Hadj Moussa, Gaoussou Diarra and Ayase Ueda form the attacking trio. Van Bronckhorst also commented on the left‑back position: "Mika Mármol is de linksback, want ik denk dat we Jordan Bos pas in de winterstop weer terug hebben. Dus daarom zijn we ook op zoek naar vervanging. Javi López van Real Sociedad? Dat is een serieuze optie ja."

Support for the hospital and charitable initiative

Beyond the on‑field clash, Feyenoord will host 700 patients from the Erasmus MC Sophia Children's Hospital for the traditional Sophia Match, raising funds for the hospital. The initiative reinforces the bond between the club and the local community during the season's first home duel.

With information from AD.nl, from Stentor.
